data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This issue is often related to the v4.2 SSO token format change. Please re-save your SSO configuration in the CloudDesk Admin Console, which will re-generate the necessary internal certificates. If using Okta, verify the Application Sign On URL format, and have affected users clear their browser cache and cookies. [T-769] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
